Industrial, EBM y The Final Cut

podcast.title: Home of Industrial Music
podcast.body: Wax Trax of Chicago emerged around 1990 as a specialist indie label for heavy industrial music, serving as the home for bands such as Ministry (fronted by Al Jourgensen), Front 242, and Front Line Assembly. "This is where we can talk about wax tracks of Chicago. It appeared around 1990. This was the home of Ministry Front II IV II, Front Line Assembly and Dozens More."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Indie Rock: Part 3

podcast.title: Industrial Music Label
podcast.body: Wax Trax was identified as one of the labels where industrial music thrived, serving as a key outlet for the genre's intense and aggressive sound before it broke into the mainstream. "Industrial lived on labels like wax tracks and mute and strange European imprints."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Influence on Pretty Hate Machine
podcast.body: The Wax Trax! label scene in America significantly influenced the musical style of Nine Inch Nails' debut album, "Pretty Hate Machine." This influence, along with harder-edged synth electronic music, shaped the sound that Trent Reznor was exploring at the time. "It probably reflected the type of music that I was influenced by, which was like the wax tracks label scene in America a lot, and harder, edged, synth, electronic music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Deep Dark Secrets of Nine Inch Nails

podcast.title: Release of Trent Reznor's "Supernaut"
podcast.body: In 1994, a Wax Trax box set provided a legitimate release for the original version of 1000 Homo DJs' cover of "Supernaut." This version was significant because it featured Trent Reznor's lead vocals, which he had asked to be removed from the original release due to legal pressures from TVT Records, leading to its prior circulation as a bootleg. "but now there's a legitimate release on a wax track's box set from 1994."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
